dipscalp.name: Dip scalp
dipscalp.note: Paper only. Buy 8-25% dips on strong coins with a positive 1h trend, sell the bounce. Size 5-25% of the pot by confidence and liquidity, never more than 2% of pool liquidity, at most 60% of the pot open.

changes.name: TrendTrader Pro
changes.lesson: Early $5-7k entry on a verified official-site CA with real-company backing (Fund A profit buyback+burn). Many copycat TTPs exist; only the CA listed on trendtrader.pro is legit. On a strong-volume pump, take initials out at +200% and let the rest trail. Small consistent wins like this are the goal.
